text: What if every American state became its own country, and they all went to war?
cap: and they all went to war?

text: California has the people: 39 million, and an economy bigger than Japan's.
Texas has the oil: more than 40 percent of America's supply.
Virginia has the navy: the largest naval base in the world, and the only shipyard that builds aircraft carriers.
cap: the largest naval base in the world

text: So who wins? Take a guess.
Probably nobody. Because all 400 of America's land-based nuclear missiles sit in just three states: Wyoming, Montana and North Dakota. Together, they have fewer people than Brooklyn.
